name: Church
overview: Scripture reveals the church as the house of God, a sacred place where God's presence dwells and His covenant is honored, as seen when Jacob recognized a location as God's house and the gate of heaven. The church is also depicted as a gathering of God's people, a place of blessing and covenant faithfulness, reflecting God's promise to bless all families through His covenant community. The establishment and building of the church is rooted in obedience to God's commands, symbolized by the setting of pillars and offerings, emphasizing the church's role as a holy sanctuary and a place of worship and prayer.
